remarks: ATTENTION BUILDERS: 33’ x 120’ interior lot offered at land value in the heart of Alberta Avenue. Embrace a community rich in culture, home to iconic local events like the Deep Freeze and Kaleidoscope arts festivals. Central location with quick access to downtown and public transit. The existing structure remains on site and requires significant work, presenting a clean canvas for new development. Buyer to verify all RMS, lot dimensions, zoning, and redevelopment permits with the City of Edmonton. (id:67522)
